verses.text: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the sons of Israel, saying, “This [is] the thing that YHWH has commanded:

segments.text: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the sons of Israel, saying, “This [is] the thing that YHWH has commanded:

verses.text: If a man makes a vow to YHWH or swears an oath to bind by some binding obligation on his soul, he shall not break his word; according to all that proceeds out of his mouth, he shall do.

segments.text: If a man makes a vow to YHWH or swears an oath to bind by some binding obligation on his soul, he shall not break his word; according to all that proceeds out of his mouth, he shall do.

verses.text: Or if a woman makes a vow to YHWH and binds [herself] by some binding obligation while in the house of her father in her youth,

segments.text: Or if a woman makes a vow to YHWH and binds [herself] by some binding obligation while in the house of her father in her youth,

verses.text: and her father hears her vow and the binding obligation by which she has bound on her soul, and her father keeps silent to her, all her vows shall stand, and every binding obligation that she has bound upon her soul shall stand.

segments.text: and her father hears her vow and the binding obligation by which she has bound on her soul, and her father keeps silent to her, all her vows shall stand, and every binding obligation that she has bound upon her soul shall stand.

verses.text: But if her father forbids her on the day that he hears, then any of her vows or her binding obligations by which she has bound on her soul shall not stand; and YHWH will release her, because her father forbade her.

verses.text: And if she is at all unto a husband, and her vows [are] on her, or a rash utterance [from] her lips by which she bound on her soul,

verses.text: and her husband hears [it] on the day that he hears, and makes no response to her, her vows shall stand, and her binding obligations by which she bound on her soul shall stand.

verses.text: And a vow of a widow or a divorced woman, any by which she has bound upon her soul shall stand against her.

verses.text: And if she has vowed [in] the house of her husband or bound by a binding obligation upon her soul with an oath,

verses.text: And if her husband keeps silent to her from day to day, he confirms all her vows, or all the binding obligations that bind her; he confirms them because he surely remained silent to her on the day that he heard [them].

verses.text: But if he surely nullifies them after he has heard [them], then he shall bear her iniquity.”

verses.text: These [are] the statutes that YHWH commanded Moses between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth [in] the house of her father.
